surface_mechanism: 88:1 presents the report of the overwhelming event as something that has arrived to the addressee.
88:2-3 presents faces, standing metonymically for persons, as humbled, laboring, and exhausted.
88:4 joins exposure to fire with extreme heat and punitive suffering.
88:5 joins forced drinking with a spring whose heat has reached its limit.
88:6 uses negation plus exception to restrict their food to the harmful plant called dari'.
